summary:
Targeted regression and performance fixes completed:
- Fixed stale-UID sync race in useFitnessSync.ts via auth generation counter, in-flight invalidation, and UID-scoped queue
- Fixed active-session reset ensuring exactly one ActiveSessionProvider, clean logout reset, and visibility flush protection
- Fixed visibilitychange listener leak on unmount in ActiveSessionContext.tsx
- Completed ExerciseCard memoization in SessionView.tsx with stable toggle and AI advice callbacks
- Enhanced Layout.tsx with continuous scroll position tracking and divergent-height restoration
- Wired Dashboard pointer/hover prewarming for SessionView chunk
- Respected reduced-motion preferences in DeferredViewSection.tsx
- Calibrated Analytics deferred section placeholder heights to prevent layout shifts
- Added comprehensive regression tests in targetedPerformanceRegressionPass2.test.tsx
- All 35 test files (574 tests), TypeScript checks, and production builds passed with 100% success rate
